evals.name: share-in-slack
evals.prompt: Export my live-render canvas to a markdown docs tree I can share in the team Slack channel. Should be self-contained and easy to read on a phone.
evals.expected_output: docs/ tree with index.md + per-region files. Mermaid blocks present. Cross-links work. Footer with provenance.

assertions.text: Output contains index.md
Output contains at least 2 per-region .md files (slug derived from region titles)
index.md contains a ```mermaid fenced code block
At least one per-region page contains a ```mermaid fenced code block
index.md contains at least one relative ./*.md link
Annotation text (pricing or retention) appears as a blockquote in some region page
A generation footer / provenance line appears on index.md
No YAML frontmatter (no leading --- block) at the top of any .md file

evals.name: mermaid-per-region
evals.prompt: Turn the canvas state into multi-file markdown with mermaid diagrams for each region. Annotations should show up as quoted callouts on whichever page they relate to.
evals.expected_output: Each region page has mermaid. Annotations on the right pages as block quotes.

assertions.text: Output contains index.md
Output contains 2 per-region .md files (one for Platform, one for Data plane)
Every per-region .md file contains a ```mermaid fenced code block
The pricing-related annotation appears as a blockquote on the Platform page (where billing+orders live)
The retention-related annotation appears as a blockquote on the Data plane page (where warehouse lives)
index.md contains a world-level mermaid diagram
No YAML frontmatter on any page

evals.name: commit-to-repo
evals.prompt: Generate a docs/ tree from the live-render workspace state that I can commit to the repo. Plain markdown, no special build tools, mermaid diagrams welcome.
evals.expected_output: Plain markdown, no auxiliary directories, mermaid in fenced blocks.

assertions.text: Output contains index.md
Output contains at least 2 per-region .md files
All output files are .md (no .html, .yaml, .json deliverables)
At least one mermaid fenced block exists somewhere in the output
Relative cross-links use ./*.md form
No frontmatter on any page
Generation footer / provenance appears on index.md
